card.tagline: traditional Manx dance connected to the hop-tu-naa festivities around 31 October in the Isle of Man
card.profile: Hop-tu-naa is a traditional Manx dance connected to the hop-tu-naa festivities around 31 October in the Isle of Man. It is a simple processional dance for any number of two pairs of dancers. The dance shares its name with the festivities and the music to which the dance is connected.
card.insight: It is not known at what date it was collected, but it was first mentioned as having been complete and collected in the Five Manx Folk Dances published in 1936.
sources: Source: Hop-tu-Naa (dance) on Wikipedia, CC BY-SA 4.0. Read: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hop-tu-Naa_(dance)
